name: Sunshine Menu
description: Sunshine Menu adds editable speed controls, BPM beat toggling, and named practice bot files.

toggle-menu.name: Toggle Mod Menu
toggle-menu.description: Open or close the in-game menu.

speed-hack.name: Speed Hack
speed-hack.description: Apply the custom speed multiplier during gameplay.

music-sync.name: BPM Beat Sync
music-sync.description: Toggle between normal and custom speed on alternating BPM beats.

song-bpm.name: Song BPM
song-bpm.description: Tempo used for beat toggling. This is BPM timing, not audio analysis.

fps-cap.name: FPS Cap
fps-cap.description: Frame cap selected in the in-game menu. Set to 0 for the game default.

show-fps.name: Show FPS
show-fps.description: Display the frame rate during gameplay.

position.name: Position
position.description: 0: top right, 1: top left, 2: bottom left, 3: bottom right.
